Demir chest zipper, shoulders, hips and chair rotate toward Nazari together; head raises toward her with a natural neck connection. Both arms connect to relaxed armrest grips with coherent fingers. Rounded nose tip, broad adult lower face, eye/brow spacing and stubble remain consistent with canonical Demir under stronger three-quarter/upward gaze. Nazari preserves mature jaw, rounded nose and age lines. Three monitor bars, separate bodies, chair geometry and tool grip remain coherent.
